sources.entry: plugNmeet - Scalable and high performance web conferencing system. (Demo, Source Code) MIT Docker/Go

summary.one_liner: plugNmeet-server is the Go backend for Plug-N-Meet, a self-hostable web conferencing system built on LiveKit WebRTC infrastructure.
summary.what_it_does: The repository holds the primary backend server for Plug-N-Meet, written in Go, which handles all API and business logic. It runs on top of a LiveKit instance for WebRTC media, uses Redis for caching and messaging, and uses MariaDB or MySQL for storage. The README describes support for simulcast and dynacast with H264, VP8, VP9, and AV1 codecs, plus MP4 recording and RTMP/RTMPS broadcasting, RTMP/WHIP ingress, and a SIP gateway for telephone dial-in. It also mentions an AI agent offering live translation, transcription, and summaries through an Artifacts API. A companion React frontend (plugNmeet-client) and a separate recorder (plugNmeet-recorder) are named as other core components. Official PHP and JavaScript SDKs and plugins for WordPress, Moodle, and Joomla are listed.
use_cases: embed meetings in a website or LMS
online classes with Moodle or WordPress
record and broadcast meetings to YouTube
collaborative whiteboard and polls in video calls
how_to_run: Create a config.yaml from config_sample.yaml and set your LiveKit, Redis, and MariaDB/MySQL details.
Optional: install libreoffice and mupdf-tools for office file support in the whiteboard.
The README points to an installation script and a full installation guide for deploying all components.
notable: Built on LiveKit WebRTC with simulcast and dynacast adaptive streaming
Optional end-to-end encryption for media and data channels
AI agent with live translation, transcription, and summaries via an Artifacts API
SIP gateway for dialing in by phone and RTMP/WHIP ingress for OBS
Ready-made plugins for WordPress, Moodle, Joomla, and LTI
caveats: Requires a separately configured LiveKit instance, Redis, and MariaDB or MySQL before it can run
Office file whiteboard support needs optional libreoffice and mupdf-tools installed
